annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and has a logarithmic scale ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, with regularly spaced tick labels at each power of two. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.4 to 0.8, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains four lines: a dark blue line with circular markers and a solid style, representing "Llama-3B," which starts at around (1, 0.42) and ends near (256, 0.9), showing a consistent upward trend. A green line with triangular markers and a dashed style represents "Llama-3B + FT," beginning around (1, 0.42) and ending near (256, 0.9), also showing an upward trend. A light blue line with circular markers and a solid style illustrates "Llama-1B," starting approximately at (1, 0.1) and ending near (256, 0.85), following an upward trend. Lastly, a light green line with triangular markers and a dashed style represents "Llama-1B + FT," which starts around (1, 0.1) and ends close to (256, 0.85), rising consistently across the x-axis.
